versions.text: For the one-gear landing conditions, the aeroplane is assumed to be in the level attitude and to contact the ground on one main landing gear, in accordance with Figure 4 of Appendix A of CS –25. In this attitude – (a) The ground reactions must be the same as those obtained on that side under CS 25.479(d)(1), and (b) Each unbalanced external load must be reacted by aeroplane inertia in a rational or conservative manner.
